CREATE TABLE `customers` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `_sprig_rk` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL INVISIBLE,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `email` (`email`),
  KEY `idx_rk` (`_sprig_rk`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci COMMENT='people'
